<answer>Percival sneaks back into the empty schoolroom, lifts the claret case under which O’Gallagher has hidden the confiscated squibs and crackers, and packs additional gunpowder under it—leaving only a tiny, hard-to-notice train in the green baize.  

When O’Gallagher sits back down on the “throne,” Percival lights the train with touchwood, setting off the stored fireworks and powder so that the claret case blasts upward and O’Gallagher is “thrown up to the ceiling” in a cloud of smoke while the crackers and squibs fizz and bang (and the schoolroom catches fire).</answer>
